purpose: Pass on something heard from another person.
keywords: Plain explanatory form + んだって; noun / な-adjective + なんだって
I hear a bookshop is opening by the station.
I heard that film was good.
formation: Plain explanatory form + んだって; noun / な-adjective + なんだって
restrictions: A conversational hearsay form; does not prove the report true.
mistake: The ん belongs to the explanatory form; noun predicates need な.
